name: Cuyahoga Falls
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Cuyahoga Falls, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio for 2026: the downtown Tree Lighting and Drone Show and the free Downtown Ice Rink.
lede: Cuyahoga Falls kicks off Christmas with a downtown tree lighting, a drone show and live reindeer, and opens a free downtown ice rink the same day.
celebrates: The City of Cuyahoga Falls Parks and Recreation Department says its annual Holiday Tree Lighting kicks off the holiday season. In 2026 it is on Saturday, November 28, with live music, ice skating, a photo booth, crafts and live reindeer, and Santa and Mayor Walters light the tree at 6 pm. A holiday drone show follows over the parking lot at 2356 Front Street. The city's downtown ice rink opens the same day at the plaza by the Downtown Pavilion, with free admission.
lastyear: We did not find a 2025 recap on a host site. An earlier Downtown Cuyahoga Falls Partnership announcement, from 2021, described the same tree lighting weekend with a DJ, photo booth, a tuba Christmas performance, ice carving demos, live reindeer, cookies and hot chocolate and train rides for kids, with Mayor Walters joining Santa on a fire truck to light the tree at about 6 pm. It also named Small Business Saturday and a December holiday display contest downtown.
facts: The downtown ice rink sits on the plaza by the Downtown Pavilion and Amphitheater at 2085 Front Street. The city lists a tentative last day of the 2026 to 2027 season of February 15, 2027, and says hockey sticks and pucks are never allowed. In 2026 the rink takes cards only, with no cash, and skate rentals cost $5 per person in sizes from Youth 1 to Adult 13.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Cuyahoga Falls itself. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs its North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in Independence from November 13 to December 22, 2026, with 5:00 pm and 7:55 pm departures and tickets listed at $60 to $110 per person, according to the railroad. The railroad is based in Peninsula, a short drive from Cuyahoga Falls.
train_links: The railroad that runs the North Pole Adventure Christmas train from Rockside Station in Independence.
traditions: Santa and the Mayor light the downtown tree, according to the city.
A holiday drone show follows the lighting over the lot at 2356 Front Street.
The city opens the plaza rink on tree lighting day, with free admission.
The city lists live reindeer among the tree lighting activities.
kidfact: At the Cuyahoga Falls tree lighting, kids can meet live reindeer and then watch a drone show light up the sky.
faq: When is the Cuyahoga Falls tree lighting 2026?
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 4:30 to 6:30 pm. The city says Santa and Mayor Walters light the tree at 6 pm, followed right away by a drone show.
Is the Cuyahoga Falls ice rink free?
Admission is free for everyone. Skate rental is $5 per person, and the rink takes cards only, no cash, this season.
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from noon to 8 pm. After that it runs Fridays 3 to 8 pm and weekends noon to 8 pm, with extra hours over winter break.
Is there a Christmas train in Cuyahoga Falls?
Not that we found. The nearest is the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad from Rockside Station in Independence.

folded.note: Peninsula Candlelight Walk and Tree Lighting is listed TBA for 2026 (not verified); Hale Farm Holiday Lantern Tours (Bath) are already live on both cleveland-oh and akron-oh (duplicate, flagged).

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Cuyahoga Falls for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, 1 of them free. The magic starts on November 28 with the Tree Lighting and Drone Show and runs through January 4 with the Downtown Ice Rink. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Cuyahoga Falls

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in Cuyahoga Falls
  • 1 free event: the Downtown Ice Rink, with free admission and $5 skate rental
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mayor Walters light the tree at 6 pm (November 28)
  • Tree and light shows: the Tree Lighting and Drone Show (November 28)
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest is the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad from Rockside Station in Independence
  • Season: November 28 to January 4 (the rink is scheduled to stay open until about February 15, 2027)
